</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_FairValueDisclosuresTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:FairValueDisclosuresTextBlock" id="ixv-22969"><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 10 &#8211; <span style="text-decoration:underline">FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENTS</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Investment in equity securities</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in">On April 22, 2025, pursuant
to the Fourth Securities Purchase Agreement, the Company issued and sold, and the investors purchased, in a private placement (the &#8220;Fourth
PIPE Financing&#8221;), <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c347" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesIssued" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-25299">6,250</ix:nonFraction> shares of its Series D Preferred Stock to investors in exchange for the receipt of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c348" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesIssued" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-25300">1,000,279</ix:nonFraction> shares of the
Stella Series D Preferred Stock, in which a portion of the Stella Series D Preferred Stock was owned by a related party investor (see
Note 13). The exchange of shares was in lieu of cash, the cost of which was initially included in investment in equity securities. The
fair value of Stella&#8217;s Series D Preferred Stock received was determined to be $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c222" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ReceivablesFairValueDisclosure" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25301">500,000</ix:nonFraction> as of the transaction date, based on the
subsequent sale of the <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c91" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockNumberOfSharesIssuedInTransaction" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-25302">1,000,279</ix:nonFraction> Stella Series D Preferred Stock $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c349" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockConsiderationReceivedOnTransaction" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25303">500,000</ix:nonFraction> in cash, pursuant to a Stock Purchase Agreement dated August
20, 2025. Accordingly, the Company determined that the fair value of the equity securities on the date of the Fourth Securities Purchase
Agreement of April 21, 2025 was equal to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c350" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:EquityFairValueAdjustment" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25304">500,000</ix:nonFraction>. Additionally, the Company recognized the issuance of its Series D Preferred Stock to
investors at a cost of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c91" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockConsiderationReceivedOnTransaction" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25305">500,000</ix:nonFraction>, which represented the fair value of the consideration received. The difference between the stated value
of the Company&#8217;s Series D Preferred Stock ($<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c351" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="cero:FairValueStatedValue" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25306">5.0</ix:nonFraction> million) and the fair value of the consideration received ($<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c351" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalMarkToMarket" scale="0" sign="-" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25307">500,000</ix:nonFraction>) was recorded
as a decrease to additional paid-in capital, which amounted to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c351" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="cero:ReductionOfCapital" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25308">4.5</ix:nonFraction> million, during the three months ended June 30, 2025. The investment
in Stella&#8217;s Series D Preferred Stock was classified as an equity security without a readily determinable fair value and was accounted
for under the measurement alternative in accordance with ASC 321,&#160;<i>Investments &#8211; Equity Securities</i>. Under this method,
the investment was initially recorded at cost, which was determined to be equal to the fair value of the consideration received, and is
subsequently adjusted for observable price changes in orderly transactions for the same or similar securities and for impairment, if any.
This non-cash transaction during the year ended December 31, 2025 did not impact the Company&#8217;s cash flows and is disclosed as a
non-cash investing and financing activity in the consolidated statement of cash flows in accordance with ASC 230,&#160;<i>Statement of
Cash Flows</i>.</p></ix:nonNumeric><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><b>CERO THERAPEUTICS HOLDINGS, INC.<br/>
NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS<br/>
December 31, 2025 and 2024</b></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p><div>

</div><ix:continuation id="_IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company has incurred significant tax losses
since inception. Based on the available objective evidence, management cannot conclude it is more likely than not that the net deferred
tax assets will be fully realizable. Accordingly, the Company has provided a full valuation allowance against its net deferred tax assets.
For the periods ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the valuation allowance increased by approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25469">5,539,000</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c186" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25470">4,040,000</ix:nonFraction>, respectively.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">At December 31, 2025, the Company has federal
net operating loss carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c5" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25471">727,000</ix:nonFraction> that begin to expire in 2036. The Company also has federal net operating losses
of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FederalStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperations" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25472">72,677,000</ix:nonFraction> that arose after the 2017 tax year that will carry forward indefinitely and the utilization of which is limited to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c432" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-25473">80</ix:nonFraction>%
of taxable income for tax years beginning after 2021. The Company has state net operating loss carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c5" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25474">72,262,000</ix:nonFraction>
that will begin to expire in 2036.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Under the Tax Reform Act of 1986, the amount of
and benefits from net operating loss carry forwards may be impaired or limited in certain circumstances. Events which cause limitations
in the amount of net operating losses that the Company may utilize in any one year include, but are not limited to, a cumulative ownership
change of more than <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeCumulativePercentageOwnershipAfterAllTransactions" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-25475">50</ix:nonFraction>%, as defined, over a three-year period. The impact of any limitations that may be imposed due to such ownership
changes has not been determined.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On July 4, 2025, the OBBBA was enacted, which
included among other provisions the restoration of immediate expensing of domestic research and experimental (&#8220;R&amp;E&#8221;) expenditures
under Section 174. Pursuant to the OBBBA&#8217;s transition rules, the Company elected to expense all unamortized domestic R&amp;E costs
previously capitalized between 2022 and 2024 in 2025. As the Company maintains a valuation allowance against its net deferred tax assets,
including NOLs, this election resulted in no change to tax expense for the year ended December 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2025, the Company has research
credit carry forwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c433" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsResearch" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25476">1,315,000</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c434" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:CurrentFederalStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBenefit" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25477">1,509,000</ix:nonFraction> for federal and state tax purposes, respectively. If not utilized, the
federal carryforward will expire in various amounts beginning in 2040. The California credits can be carried forward indefinitely. The
Company has not undertaken a detailed analysis of all amounts claimed as research credits for federal or state tax purposes. As a result,
amounts ultimately realized for research credits were included in management&#8217;s consideration of uncertain tax benefits.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company
had an unrecognized tax benefit balance of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c5" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25478">549,000</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c6" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-25479">538,000</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, related to R&amp;D credits.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">No amount of unrecognized tax benefits as of December
31, 2025 and 2024, if recognized, would reduce the Company&#8217;s effective tax rate because the benefits would be in the form of tax
credit carryforwards, which would attract a full valuation allowance. There are no provisions for which it is reasonably possible that
the total amounts of unrecognized tax benefits will significantly increase or decrease within 12 months of the reporting date. Because
the statute of limitations does not expire until after the net operating loss and credit carryforwards are actually used, the statutes
are still open on calendar years ended 2016 and 2017 forward for federal and state purposes.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company did not recognize any expense for
interest and penalties related to uncertain tax positions during 2025 and 2024, and the Company does not have any amounts related to interest
and penalties accrued as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company files U.S. federal and state tax returns.
The Company&#8217;s tax years will remain open for examination by the federal and state authorities for three and four years, respectively,
from the date of utilization of any net operating loss credit.</p>

<p style="text-indent: 0.25in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>
